preconditions.expression: isinstance(s, str) and len(s) > 0 and len(s) <= 100
preconditions.description: The input string s must be a non-empty string with a length between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABC.' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s must only contain the characters 'A', 'B', 'C', and '.'.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Yes' if any((s[i-1] in 'ABC' and s[i+1] in 'ABC') for i in range(1, len(s)-1)) else stdout == 'No'
postconditions.description: The output is 'Yes' if there exists a cell that can contain all three colors after some flowers wither, otherwise it is 'No'.
